from.n: acl enforce: an ordinary opener cannot claim or write a new space

to.n: v2-server-acl > `enforce` mode > leaves a new space unclaimed by an ordinary opener and returns `AuthorizationError` for their write

from.n: acl enforce: the space identity initializes a private space

to.n: v2-server-acl > `enforce` mode > accepts the space identity's genesis ACL, then admits the granted owner and refuses everyone else

from.n: acl enforce: WRITE grant allows transact but not ACL-doc writes

to.n: v2-server-acl > `enforce` mode > accepts a transact under a `WRITE` grant and returns `AuthorizationError` for its ACL-document write

from.n: acl enforce: READ grant allows queries but not writes

to.n: v2-server-acl > `enforce` mode > accepts a graph query under a `READ` grant and returns `AuthorizationError` for its write

from.n: acl enforce: '*' READ opens the space to any principal read-only

to.n: v2-server-acl > `enforce` mode > opens the space to any principal read-only under a `"*"` `READ` grant

from.n: acl enforce: service DIDs have implicit OWNER and do not claim spaces

to.n: v2-server-acl > `enforce` mode > gives a service DID implicit `OWNER` without claiming the space for it

from.n: acl enforce: principal equal to the space DID can claim it privately

to.n: v2-server-acl > `enforce` mode > accepts a private claim from the principal equal to the space DID

from.n: acl enforce: revoking a grant takes effect for subsequent messages

to.n: v2-server-acl > `enforce` mode > revokes the session of a principal whose grant is removed and refuses its later messages

from.n: acl enforce: revocation during resumed catch-up fails the open

to.n: v2-server-acl > `enforce` mode > fails a resumed open with `SessionRevokedError` when revocation lands during its catch-up

from.n: acl enforce: a taken-over session cannot finish an in-flight transaction

to.n: v2-server-acl > `enforce` mode > rejects a taken-over session's in-flight transaction with `SessionError`

from.n: acl enforce: a concurrent post-revocation write is rejected

to.n: v2-server-acl > `enforce` mode > rejects a write queued behind the revocation of its session

from.n: acl enforce: a concurrent graph query is evaluated before revocation

to.n: v2-server-acl > `enforce` mode > evaluates a graph query queued ahead of a revocation against the old ACL

from.n: acl enforce: revocation settles an in-flight query with a typed error

to.n: v2-server-acl > `enforce` mode > settles an in-flight query with `SessionRevokedError` after the revocation

from.n: acl enforce: a concurrent watch set is evaluated before revocation

to.n: v2-server-acl > `enforce` mode > evaluates a watch set queued ahead of a revocation against the old ACL

from.n: acl enforce: an in-flight refresh cannot emit after revocation

to.n: v2-server-acl > `enforce` mode > emits nothing from an in-flight refresh once the session is revoked

from.n: acl enforce: owner removing their own access still gets the commit response

to.n: v2-server-acl > `enforce` mode > returns the commit response to an owner who removes their own access before revoking them

from.n: acl enforce: legacy data without an ACL is authenticated public read/write

to.n: v2-server-acl > `enforce` mode > grants authenticated `READ` and `WRITE` but never `OWNER` on a legacy space without an ACL

from.n: acl enforce: the space identity can privatize a legacy home space

to.n: v2-server-acl > `enforce` mode > accepts the space identity's claim on a legacy home space and revokes its public readers

from.n: acl enforce: ACL mutations must preserve a concrete owner

to.n: v2-server-acl > `enforce` mode > returns `ProtocolError` for an ACL mutation that leaves no concrete owner

from.n: acl enforce: a genesis ACL without a concrete OWNER is refused and the space stays uninitialized

to.n: v2-server-acl > `enforce` mode > returns `ProtocolError` for a genesis ACL without a concrete `OWNER` and leaves the space uninitialized

from.n: acl enforce: ACL mutations are default-branch ACL-only commits

to.n: v2-server-acl > `enforce` mode > returns `ProtocolError` for an ACL mutation on a non-default branch or mixed with ordinary writes

from.n: acl enforce: auxiliary read and operator surfaces honor capabilities

to.n: v2-server-acl > `enforce` mode > gates the auxiliary read and operator surfaces by capability

from.n: acl enforce: entity identifier reads require READ capability

to.n: v2-server-acl > `enforce` mode > returns `AuthorizationError` for entity identifier reads without `READ`

from.n: acl enforce: direct writes cannot create or mutate ACL state

to.n: v2-server-acl > `enforce` mode > rejects a direct write that would create or mutate ACL state

from.n: acl enforce: direct writes reject malformed stored ACL state

to.n: v2-server-acl > `enforce` mode > rejects a direct write when the stored ACL state is malformed

from.n: acl enforce: malformed and ownerless stored ACLs fail closed

to.n: v2-server-acl > `enforce` mode > fails closed on a malformed or ownerless stored ACL, in `observe` mode as well

from.n: acl enforce: a retracted ACL fails closed instead of becoming public

to.n: v2-server-acl > `enforce` mode > fails closed on a retracted ACL instead of making the space public

from.n: acl observe: stranger is allowed but the would-deny is counted

to.n: v2-server-acl > `observe` mode > admits a stranger and counts the would-deny

from.n: acl observe: fresh-space genesis remains a hard invariant

to.n: v2-server-acl > `observe` mode > returns `AuthorizationError` for an ordinary write to a fresh space until its genesis ACL lands

from.n: acl off: no seeding, no gating

to.n: v2-server-acl > `off` mode > seeds no commit and gates nothing

from.n: acl default: absent acl option behaves like off

to.n: v2-server-acl > no `acl` option > opens a new space without seeding a commit, as `off` mode does

from.n: OW31 acl enforce: a delegating principal acting as space-owner READS an owner-only space; its writes and ACL-doc writes stay refused

to.n: v2-server-acl > the delegated READ binding (OW31) > `enforce` mode > admits a delegating principal acting as space-owner to read an owner-only space, and refuses its writes and ACL-document writes

from.n: OW31 acl enforce: the actingAs marker from a NON-delegating principal is refused loudly

to.n: v2-server-acl > the delegated READ binding (OW31) > `enforce` mode > returns `AuthorizationError` naming the delegating class for an `actingAs` marker from a non-delegating principal

from.n: OW31 acl enforce: a delegating principal cannot initialize a fresh space's genesis (not a service DID)

to.n: v2-server-acl > the delegated READ binding (OW31) > `enforce` mode > refuses a fresh space's genesis ACL from a delegating principal that is not a service DID

from.n: OW31 acl enforce: an ACL change that removes the bound owner revokes the delegating session

to.n: v2-server-acl > the delegated READ binding (OW31) > `enforce` mode > revokes the delegating session when an ACL change removes the bound owner

from.n: OW31 acl enforce: an ownership TRANSFER re-binds — the bound session is revoked even when the stale acting principal retains READ (a self-owned space included)

to.n: v2-server-acl > the delegated READ binding (OW31) > `enforce` mode > revokes the bound session on an ownership transfer even when the stale acting principal retains `READ`

from.n: OW31 acl enforce: an unknown actingAs value is a ProtocolError; a multi-owner ACL binds the lexicographically first concrete owner

to.n: v2-server-acl > the delegated READ binding (OW31) > `enforce` mode > returns `ProtocolError` for an unknown `actingAs` value, and binds a multi-owner ACL to its lexicographically first concrete owner

from.n: OW31 acl enforce: an OWNER-class service envelope stores NO binding — its authority is the operator grant, and an ownership transfer does not revoke it (D2/D3)

to.n: v2-server-acl > the delegated READ binding (OW31) > `enforce` mode > stores no binding for an `OWNER`-class service envelope, so an ownership transfer does not revoke it

from.n: OW31 acl observe: a bound session's envelope write is a counted would-deny (the canary's mechanism)

to.n: v2-server-acl > the delegated READ binding (OW31) > `observe` mode > admits a bound session's envelope write and counts it as a would-deny

from.n: OW31 acl off: the actingAs marker is inert (off preserves historical behavior)

to.n: v2-server-acl > the delegated READ binding (OW31) > `off` mode > admits an open carrying the `actingAs` marker, which has no effect

from.n: sameAcl: exact principals and capabilities, key order free, never an array or scalar

to.n: v2-server-acl > sameAcl() > returns `true` only for the exact principals and capabilities in any key order, and `false` for an array or scalar
